policy.classification: no start evidence; timeout; worker error; missing controller; controller conflict; missing/invalid record; task result
policy.cost: unknown for all attempts; historical zero cost is a placeholder
policy.denominator: all evidenced starts including failures/timeouts; planned and unknown-start counts also retained
policy.missing_usage: unknown, never zero; totals only complete when every started attempt has usage
policy.start_evidence: controller close result or worker-created record/log; no independent PID start ledger exists
